The average distance from Earth to the Sun is about 1 astronomical unit (AU), which equals approximately 149.6 million kilometers (≈92.96 million miles), or about 1.496 × 10^11 meters.

Because Earth's orbit is elliptical, the distance varies:
- Perihelion (closest): ≈147.1 million km (≈91.4 million mi)  
- Aphelion (farthest): ≈152.1 million km (≈94.5 million mi)
